description: This file defines the IGoogleCast interface and related nested classes and structures for managing Google Cast functionality, including runtime management, status reporting, and event notifications within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IGoogleCast
classes.description: Interface for Google Cast control, status, and event notifications.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::IRuntimeManagerDelegate
classes.description: Delegate interface for managing runtime actions like launch, close, destroy, and notifications.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::CastStatus
classes.description: Structure representing the current status of the Cast shell, including build number and state.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for Google Cast status updates.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for Google Cast status updates.

methods.name: GetCastStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the Cast shell.
